edits.name: rohit
edits.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / background-extraction. Edit target: the single supplied academic portrait. Background cleanup only. Remove the two thin black vertical border lines and side-strip artifacts from the background. Replace the background with a seamless solid pure white (#ffffff) background. Preserve the person's face, facial features, expression, gaze, skin tone and skin texture, hair, glasses, forehead mark if present, facial hair, clothing, body proportions and exact pose as faithfully as possible. Do not beautify, smooth skin, change lighting on the person, change clothes, invent accessories, alter expression, or recompose the shot. Preserve original framing and aspect ratio. Clean natural hair edges; no gray halos, borders, shadows, text or gradients. This will be used as an authentic portrait on a university award poster. Return only the edited individual photograph.
